newsitem.title: USA: L.A. T says court denies plaintiff motion.
newsitem.headline: L.A. T says court denies plaintiff motion.

text.p: L.A. T Sportswear Inc said on Friday that a federal court has turned down a request to reconsider its prior order denying class certification of a lawsuit filed against the company.

The lawsuit had been filed by Edward Slate in March 1994 accusing the company, its directors, executive officers and the managing underwriter of providing misleading documents for its initial public offering.

In May 1995, Omega Partners LP filed a separate class action. On August 19, 1996, the court denied Slate's motion for class certification, and on August 30, Omega voluntarily withdrew its lawsuit, the company said.
"We feel vindicated by the court's decision. We have always believed that these actions are groundless," L.A. T Sportswear Chairman and Chief Executive Isador Mitzner said in a statement.
